metadata.user_request: Improve data quality for BI analysis while preserving the uploaded original. This is an academic experimentation run: propose and test a generated cleaning method with test_generated using complete transform(df) code when it adds value, then apply a passing candidate with apply_candidate with an assessment. If Docker is unavailable, stop with a clear error. For a failed generated method, use the bounded correction pipeline; do not fall back to builtin methods.
